record.title: Acquire a new RF survey using raw frequency qualification
record.intent: Measure the connected source/cable/CH1 chain without mistaking built-in frequency quantization for a source failure.
requirements: Follow docs/research/rf-raw-qualified-survey-protocol.md after admission and commit/push. Preserve the failed survey and discriminator; no firmware, software-policy, entitlement, calibration or wiring changes.

Verify USB ancestry/no other owner per visit, isolated lease/default-route/forwarding/NAT checks under fresh full capture. Use exactly the frozen twelve visits and five fresh100kRAWASCII records at each, raw power0 and fixed50mV/div/1us/div/4GSa/s profile.

Retain built-in frequency as an observation only. Keep Vpp/extrema, metadata/count/rate and raw-range guards; qualify each fresh supplied record online using the frozen receive guard, preserving every profile/result and exact socket response bytes.

Stop on capture/transport/network, uncertain source write, range, metadata or receive-guard failure. No retries/newpoints; retain all acquired and censored slots. Restore original scope/export/RUN while healthy, final100MHz anchor only if reached and no extra serial cleanup.
Gracefully stop capture retaining drop counters, remove temporary host address/helper, seal/verify acquisition before final numerical reduction, and commit/push the acquisition conclusion.
acceptance: The newly frozen sixty-record survey or exact bounded failure is preserved with raw frequency qualification
